regimens.name: Osimertinib (Tagrisso)
regimens.rationale: FLAURA: superior PFS/OS vs 1st-gen TKIs. Standard for EGFR sensitizing mutations.
regimens.resistance_note: Watch MET amplification, ERBB2 amplification, RB1+TP53 (SCLC transformation risk).
regimens.patient_explanation: A daily pill that blocks the mutated EGFR growth signal.

regimens.name: Sotorasib or Adagrasib (G12C)
regimens.rationale: Covalent G12C inhibitors; CodeBreaK 200 / KRYSTAL-12 confirm PFS benefit post-chemo-IO.
regimens.resistance_note: Adaptive RTK rebound (MET/EGFR/RET amplification) and STK11/KEAP1 co-mutation blunt durability.
regimens.patient_explanation: A targeted pill for the specific KRAS G12C variant, if present.

regimens.name: Lorlatinib (Lorbrena) or Alectinib
regimens.rationale: CROWN/ALEX: deep CNS-active responses for ALK fusions.
regimens.resistance_note: Compound ALK mutations and TP53 co-alteration shorten duration.
regimens.patient_explanation: A targeted pill blocking the ALK fusion protein driving the tumor.

regimens.name: Crizotinib or Repotrectinib
regimens.rationale: TRIDENT-1: repotrectinib active in TKI-naive and resistant ROS1+ NSCLC.
regimens.patient_explanation: A targeted pill blocking the ROS1 fusion oncoprotein.

regimens.name: Selpercatinib (Retevmo) or Pralsetinib
regimens.rationale: LIBRETTO-001: high intracranial ORR in RET-fusion lung cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: A targeted drug for RET-fusion positive tumors.

regimens.name: Capmatinib or Tepotinib; Amivantamab (exon14)
regimens.rationale: GEOMETRY/VISION: MET exon14 skipping and high-level MET amplification respond to MET TKIs; amivantamab approved for exon20 insertions and post-osimertinib settings.
regimens.patient_explanation: Therapy targeting abnormal MET signaling.

regimens.name: Dabrafenib + Trametinib
regimens.rationale: Dual blockade controls BRAF V600E NSCLC; reduces paradoxical MAPK activation.
regimens.patient_explanation: Two targeted pills that shut down the BRAF growth pathway.

regimens.name: Larotrectinib or Repotrectinib
regimens.rationale: Histology-agnostic approval for NTRK fusions with ~75% ORR.
regimens.patient_explanation: A targeted drug active against NTRK gene fusions.

regimens.name: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (Enhertu)
regimens.rationale: DESTINY-Lung01/02: 55% ORR in HER2-mutant NSCLC; DESTINY-PanTumor02 led to site-agnostic approval.
regimens.patient_explanation: An antibody-drug conjugate delivering chemotherapy directly to HER2+ cells.

regimens.name: Pembrolizumab (+/- chemotherapy)
regimens.rationale: KEYNOTE-158/189: TMB-H predicts pembrolizumab benefit.
regimens.resistance_note: STK11/KEAP1 co-mutations predict IO-refractory behavior despite TMB-H.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy that helps your immune system attack the tumor.

regimens.name: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan; (1L: Pertuzumab+Trastuzumab+taxane)
regimens.rationale: DESTINY-Breast03: T-DXd doubled PFS vs T-DM1 in 2L HER2+.
regimens.patient_explanation: HER2-targeted therapy; T-DXd is the current preferred 2nd line.

regimens.name: Alpelisib + Fulvestrant; or Capivasertib + Fulvestrant
regimens.rationale: SOLAR-1/CAPItello-291: PIK3CA/AKT-pathway blockade post-CDK4/6i.
regimens.resistance_note: PTEN loss favors capivasertib (AKT inhibitor) over alpelisib.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted therapy blocking the overactive PI3K growth switch.

regimens.name: Elacestrant (Orserdu) or Fulvestrant
regimens.rationale: EMERALD: elacestrant superior to SoC in ESR1-mutant post-CDK4/6i disease.
regimens.patient_explanation: An oral estrogen-receptor degrader that works despite ESR1 resistance mutations.

regimens.name: Olaparib or Talazoparib
regimens.rationale: OlympiAD/EMBRACA: PARPi superior to chemo in germline BRCA HER2- metastatic breast cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: A pill exploiting the tumor's DNA-repair weakness.

regimens.name: Olaparib or Talazoparib
regimens.rationale: Same OlympiAD/EMBRACA evidence base as BRCA1.
regimens.patient_explanation: A pill exploiting the tumor's DNA-repair weakness.

regimens.name: Platinum (Carboplatin) or PARP inhibitor
regimens.rationale: TNT/PrECOG: HRD predicts platinum sensitivity.
regimens.patient_explanation: Therapy exploiting defective DNA repair in the tumor.

regimens.name: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (Enhertu)
regimens.rationale: DESTINY-Breast03.
regimens.patient_explanation: HER2-targeted antibody-drug conjugate.

regimens.name: Adagrasib or Sotorasib + Cetuximab (G12C)
regimens.rationale: KRYSTAL-1/CodeBreaK-300: EGFR feedback requires dual blockade in CRC.
regimens.resistance_note: Acquired KRAS amplification/secondary mutations and RTK activation limit durability.
regimens.patient_explanation: Two-drug targeted combination for the KRAS G12C mutation.

regimens.name: Encorafenib + Cetuximab (+/- Binimetinib)
regimens.rationale: BEACON CRC: doublet/triplet improves OS in BRAF V600E mCRC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted combination for BRAF-mutant colorectal cancer.

regimens.name: Trastuzumab + Tucatinib or T-DXd
regimens.rationale: MOUNTAINEER/DESTINY-CRC01: HER2-amplified RAS-WT CRC responds to HER2 blockade.
regimens.patient_explanation: HER2-targeted therapy for HER2-amplified tumors.

regimens.name: Pembrolizumab (or Nivolumab +/- Ipilimumab)
regimens.rationale: KEYNOTE-177: pembrolizumab doubled PFS vs chemo in MSI-H mCRC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy effective in repair-deficient (MSI-high) tumors.

regimens.name: Encorafenib + Cetuximab
regimens.rationale: BEACON CRC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted combination for BRAF V600E colorectal cancer.

regimens.name: Olaparib (+Abiraterone) or Rucaparib
regimens.rationale: PROfound/TRITON3: PARPi superior to ARPI switch in HRR-mutant mCRPC.
regimens.patient_explanation: A pill exploiting DNA-repair weakness in BRCA-mutant prostate cancer.

regimens.name: Olaparib (+Abiraterone) or Rucaparib
regimens.rationale: PROfound: strongest benefit in BRCA2 subgroup.
regimens.patient_explanation: A pill exploiting DNA-repair weakness in BRCA-mutant prostate cancer.

regimens.name: Olaparib (emerging) / ATR inhibitor trials
regimens.rationale: ATM-altered mCRPC shows intermediate PARPi benefit.
regimens.patient_explanation: DNA-repair targeted therapy.

regimens.name: AKT-pathway agents (ipatasertib trials) + ARPI
regimens.rationale: IPATential150: AKT blockade improves rPFS in PTEN-loss mCRPC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Therapy targeting the PTEN-loss growth pathway.

regimens.name: Olaparib or Rucaparib
regimens.rationale: PROfound/TRITON3.
regimens.patient_explanation: PARP inhibitor for DNA-repair-deficient prostate cancer.

regimens.name: AKT pathway / trials
regimens.rationale: PTEN loss sensitizes to AKT blockade.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted therapy for PTEN-deleted tumors.

regimens.name: Olaparib/Niraparib maintenance
regimens.rationale: SOLO-1: durable benefit in BRCA-mutant advanced ovarian cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: Maintenance pill that prevents the tumor from repairing DNA damage.

regimens.name: Olaparib/Niraparib maintenance
regimens.rationale: SOLO-1/PAOLA-1.
regimens.patient_explanation: Maintenance pill exploiting DNA-repair deficiency.

regimens.name: Niraparib or Olaparib+Bevacizumab maintenance
regimens.rationale: PAOLA-1/PRIMA: HRD predicts maintenance benefit.
regimens.patient_explanation: Maintenance therapy for DNA-repair-deficient tumors.

regimens.name: PARP inhibitor
regimens.rationale: SOLO-1.
regimens.patient_explanation: PARP inhibitor maintenance.

regimens.name: Mirvetuximab Soravtansine (Elahere)
regimens.rationale: SORAYA/MIRASOL: FRa-high platinum-resistant ovarian cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: Antibody-drug conjugate targeting folate receptor alpha.

regimens.name: Dabrafenib+Trametinib or Encorafenib+Binimetinib; or Nivo+Ipi
regimens.rationale: DREAMseq: immunotherapy-first preferred for most; BRAF/MEK remains for rapid response need.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted doublet or immunotherapy depending on disease pace.

regimens.name: BRAF/MEK combination
regimens.rationale: COMBI-v/coBRIM.
regimens.patient_explanation: Two targeted pills blocking BRAF signaling.

regimens.name: Immunotherapy +/- MEK trials
regimens.rationale: NF1-mutant melanoma is typically UV-high-TMB and IO-responsive.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy favored in NF1-mutant melanoma.

regimens.name: Imatinib
regimens.rationale: KIT-mutant mucosal/acral melanoma responds to KIT inhibitors.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted therapy for KIT-mutant melanoma.

regimens.name: Platinum + Olaparib maintenance (POLO)
regimens.rationale: POLO: olaparib maintenance after platinum response in gBRCA PDAC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Maintenance targeted therapy after responding to platinum chemo.

regimens.name: Platinum + Olaparib maintenance (POLO)
regimens.rationale: POLO trial.
regimens.patient_explanation: Maintenance targeted therapy after platinum response.

regimens.name: mFOLFIRINOX or Gem/Nab-paclitaxel; KRAS inhibitors in trials (G12C: adagrasib)
regimens.rationale: KRAS-mutant PDAC remains chemotherapy-managed; G12C inhibitors emerging (KRYSTAL-1 PDAC cohort).
regimens.patient_explanation: Combination chemotherapy; targeted trials exist for KRAS G12C.

regimens.name: Zenocutuzumab (Bizengri)
regimens.rationale: eNRGy: bispecific HER2/HER3 blockade active in NRG1-fusion PDAC and NSCLC.
regimens.patient_explanation: A bispecific antibody for NRG1-fusion pancreatic cancer.

regimens.name: Larotrectinib
regimens.rationale: Site-agnostic NTRK approval; PDAC cohort enriched for fusions.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted therapy for NTRK-fusion tumors.

regimens.name: Erdafitinib (Balversa)
regimens.rationale: BLC2001/THOR: erdafitinib in FGFR2/3-altered urothelial cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for FGFR-altered bladder cancer.

regimens.name: Erdafitinib (Balversa)
regimens.rationale: THOR: OS benefit vs chemo in FGFR-altered UC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for FGFR3-altered bladder cancer.

regimens.name: Pembrolizumab or Enfortumab Vedotin + Pembro (1L)
regimens.rationale: EV-302 practice-changing 1L standard; TMB-H enriches IO benefit.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy combination, now first-line standard.

regimens.name: VEGF-TKI + IO (e.g., Pembrolizumab+Axitinib); Belzutifan (VHL disease)
regimens.rationale: KEYNOTE-426 era standards; HIF-2a inhibitor belzutifan approved for VHL-associated RCC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Combination therapy blocking tumor blood supply and boosting immunity.

regimens.name: IO-based combinations (favorable context)
regimens.rationale: PBRM1 loss correlates with enhanced IO benefit in ccRCC (biomarker, not approval).
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy combination.

regimens.name: Trastuzumab + chemo (1L); T-DXd (2L)
regimens.rationale: ToGA + DESTINY-Gastric01: HER2+ gastric/GEJ benefit.
regimens.patient_explanation: HER2-targeted therapy.

regimens.name: Zolbetuximab + chemo (CLDN18.2+)
regimens.rationale: SPOTLIGHT/GLOW: first CLDN18.2-targeted approval.
regimens.patient_explanation: Antibody targeting a gastric-cancer surface protein.

regimens.name: Checkpoint immunotherapy (ultramutated context)
regimens.rationale: POLE-ultramutated tumors have exceptional IO sensitivity (prognostic class in TCGA).
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy works especially well in POLE-mutant tumors.

regimens.name: Dostarlimab or Pembrolizumab (dMMR/MSI-H)
regimens.rationale: GARNET/RUBY: dostarlimab high ORR in dMMR endometrial cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy for repair-deficient tumors.

regimens.name: Ivosidenib (Tibsovo)
regimens.rationale: ClarIDHy: ivosidenib in IDH1-mutant cholangiocarcinoma.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for IDH1-mutant bile-duct cancer.

regimens.name: Pemigatinib or Futibatinib
regimens.rationale: FIGHT-202/FOENIX: FGFR2 fusions in intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for FGFR2-fusion bile-duct cancer.

regimens.name: Dabrafenib+Trametinib (tumor-agnostic V600E)
regimens.rationale: ROAR basket trial.
regimens.patient_explanation: BRAF-targeted therapy.

regimens.name: Vorasidenib (grade 2 glioma)
regimens.rationale: INDIGO: first targeted therapy for IDH-mutant low-grade glioma.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for IDH-mutant glioma.

regimens.name: Vorasidenib (grade 2 glioma)
regimens.rationale: INDIGO covers IDH1/2.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for IDH-mutant glioma.

regimens.name: Dabrafenib+Trametinib (pediatric LGG; tovorafenib)
regimens.rationale: FIREFLY-1: tovorafenib approved for BRAF-altered pediatric low-grade glioma.
regimens.patient_explanation: RAF-targeted therapy for BRAF-altered glioma.

regimens.name: Imatinib
regimens.rationale: Transformative targeted therapy in KIT-mutant GIST.
regimens.patient_explanation: First-line targeted pill for KIT-mutant GIST.

regimens.name: Imatinib (D842V-resistant -> Avapritinib)
regimens.rationale: NAVIGATOR: avapritinib for PDGFRA D842V GIST.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted therapy for PDGFRA-mutant GIST.

regimens.name: Pembrolizumab +/- chemo
regimens.rationale: KEYNOTE-048: pembrolizumab first-line in R/M HNSCC.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy first-line option.

regimens.name: Selpercatinib or Pralsetinib
regimens.rationale: LIBRETTO-001: RET-fusion/mutant thyroid cancer.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted pill for RET-altered thyroid cancer.

regimens.name: Dabrafenib+Trametinib (anaplastic)
regimens.rationale: Anaplastic thyroid carcinoma approval.
regimens.patient_explanation: BRAF-targeted combination.

regimens.name: Larotrectinib
regimens.rationale: Site-agnostic NTRK approval.
regimens.patient_explanation: Targeted therapy for NTRK-fusion tumors.

regimens.name: Nivolumab+Ipilimumab (1L); PARP/EZH2 trials
regimens.rationale: CheckMate-743: dual-IO standard; BAP1 loss marks synthetic-lethal targets in trials.
regimens.patient_explanation: Dual immunotherapy first-line.

regimens.name: Pembrolizumab; Tisotumab Vedotin (2L)
regimens.rationale: KEYNOTE-826 + innovaTV-301.
regimens.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy or tissue-factor ADC.

MSI-H.name: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda)
MSI-H.rationale: First tissue-agnostic approval (KEYNOTE-158) for MSI-H/dMMR tumors.
MSI-H.patient_explanation: Immunotherapy for repair-deficient tumors regardless of location.

TMB-H.name: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda)
TMB-H.rationale: KEYNOTE-158: site-agnostic approval for TMB-H solid tumors.

NTRK_fusion.name: Larotrectinib or Entrectinib/Repotrectinib
NTRK_fusion.rationale: NTRK fusions are among the highest-value actionable alterations.

BRAF_V600E.name: Dabrafenib + Trametinib
BRAF_V600E.rationale: ROAR/CTMT212X2101 basket trials; site-agnostic V600E approval.

HER2_IHC3.name: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (Enhertu)
HER2_IHC3.rationale: DESTINY-PanTumor02: first tumor-agnostic HER2 ADC approval.

POLE.name: Checkpoint inhibitor (ultramutated context)
POLE.rationale: POLE proofreading defects produce extreme neoantigen load and exceptional IO sensitivity.

NRG1_fusion.name: Zenocutuzumab (Bizengri)
NRG1_fusion.rationale: eNRGy: site-agnostic approval for NRG1-fusion solid tumors.
